transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I’ve been seeing and hearing things at work and at home that no one else seems to notice, and it’s starting to scare me. I just don't know what is real anymore and I really need some help.
How long have these seeing and hearing experiences been happening, and have you recently started any new medicines, used alcohol or drugs, or had any head injury or other medical illness?

I've been steadily hearing the whispers and seeing those shadowy figures for about ten months now, though my overall struggles started fifteen months ago after a reorganization at work. I haven't started any new medications, I don't use drugs or alcohol, and I haven't had any head injuries or physical illnesses.
Have you ever had a brain illness, seizure, stroke, high fever, or another medical problem around the time these symptoms began?
No, I haven't had anything like that. I've never had a seizure, stroke, brain illness, or even a high fever around the time all of this started.

Besides hearing whispers and seeing shadowy figures, have you noticed any unusual beliefs, like feeling watched, controlled, or that others are trying to harm you? Also, have your thoughts ever felt confused, jumbled, or hard to follow?

Yes, I’ve been convinced that company emails and calendar invites are actually coded messages, like my boss and coworkers are quietly coordinating to test me or push me out. When I try to explain what's going on, my thoughts race so fast that I jump from one idea to another, and people get really confused and can't seem to follow me.
Have these delusions and disorganized thoughts been present continuously for at least 6 months, or did they start suddenly and last less than 1 month?

They didn't start suddenly—they've been going on steadily for about ten months now. They actually started building up gradually ever since my company went through that major reorganization about fifteen months ago.
Have you noticed a decrease in motivation, emotional expression, or interest in things you used to enjoy, such as becoming more withdrawn or less able to work and care for yourself?

Yes, during my low periods I feel completely flat and blank, often just staring at my computer and skipping the art group and hikes I used to love because I can't bring myself to care. Because of this, I've missed major deadlines, had projects taken away, and my wife has had to take over managing our household bills and appointments.
Did the hallucinations, delusions, and disorganized thinking come on suddenly and fully develop within less than 1 month, or have they been present and steadily ongoing for longer than 1 month?

They definitely didn't appear overnight or within just a single month. These experiences have been steadily ongoing and building up for about ten months now, starting after the reorganization fifteen months ago. It has been a long, continuous struggle rather than a sudden shift.

Have you ever had a period when these hallucinations, delusions, and disorganized thoughts started suddenly and then completely resolved within 1 month, or have they been continuously present for longer than 1 month?

No, they have never suddenly resolved or gone away within a month. Since they started about ten months ago, the whispers, shadowy figures, and beliefs about the emails have been continuously present without any breaks.

opening_question.question: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The presentation is most consistent with paranoid schizophrenia: persistent auditory and visual hallucinations, persecutory delusions, and disorganized thought/speech have been present continuously for about 10 months, with clear functional decline at work and at home. There is no evidence of substance use, medical/neurologic cause, or a brief psychotic episode. Mood symptoms are not prominent enough to suggest a primary mood disorder with psychosis.
